acquisition_change.reason: Dryad public file-download endpoints returned HTTP 403/401 from GitHub-hosted runners.
acquisition_change.allowed_change: Acquire the already-frozen public Dryad files locally on the analyst workstation and verify deposited digests before any schema inspection or outcome calculation.

frozen_method.max_speed_rationale: Frozen before fallback scoring as the larger of the two already-selected real Stage E candidate-speed gates; not selected from Dryad outcomes.
frozen_method.proposal_temperature_rule: pairwise maximum link distance divided by 2

local_pipeline_gates.requirement: Verify the Dryad deposited MD5 before opening archive members.
Inventory archive members and inspect formats/column names only. Do not calculate tracking-method performance.
Commit the exact source-member mapping, units, cell-type filter, time rule, coordinate conversion and inclusion rules before evaluation.
Convert all three eligible experiments to the canonical trajectory schema and record SHA-256 identities of normalized files.
Run the frozen method on every eligible experiment without retuning or experiment selection.
Report biological n=3 separately from track/cell counts and retain all negative results.

association: association_error_auprc: calibrated uncertainty versus distance confidence
selective_link_risk_at_80_percent_coverage: calibrated uncertainty versus calibrated full coverage
tracking: link F1: uncertainty-compatible p>=0.5 versus hard nearest-neighbour

statistics.small_n_interpretation: descriptive/sensitivity evidence; no precise population-level inference

hard_stop_conditions: fewer than three experiment identities in the deposited tracking data
glioma trajectories cannot be separated from microglia without ambiguous outcome-guided choices
time-resolved x/y trajectories cannot be reconstructed unambiguously
reference labels are generated by the method under evaluation

claim_boundary.allowed: confirmatory external technical transfer in three independent rat glioma brain-slice experiments if all gates pass
not_allowed: retrospective conversion of Stage E REVISE to GO
